dashboard.label: TA-sanpath Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype sanpath:metrics); series prefixed 'sanpath.'.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-sanpath" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

single.option: key beacon within 3h - enter a key on the License page

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-sanpath. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-sanpath requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-sanpath", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-sanpath/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host

panel.title: All sanpath.* series (counts + per-map path state)

search.query: | mstats avg("sanpath.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "sanpath.*"
| mstats avg("sanpath.*_active_paths") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "sanpath.*_active_paths"
| mstats avg("sanpath.*_failed_paths") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "sanpath.*_failed_paths"
